name: Hearth & Home
description: Cosy countryside B&B site where the sky moves from dawn to starry night as you scroll, with parallax room cards and a date enquiry form.
features: Scroll-linked sky that crossfades dawn, day, dusk and night with a moving sun and rising moon
Illustrated room cards with gentle parallax art and nightly prices
'A day here' timeline card floating over the sunset sky
Larder add-ons, guestbook quotes, house notes FAQ and arrival/departure form
signature: The page sky shifts from dawn to dusk to a starry night as you scroll, with an arcing sun and rising moon
